plugins.prepareCmd: node scripts/release-version.mjs ${nextRelease.version} && pnpm exec biome format --write package.json
plugins.publishCmd: docker buildx build -t "$IMAGE:${nextRelease.version}" -t "$IMAGE:latest" --push . && helm package charts/dingorg && helm push dingorg-${nextRelease.version}.tgz "oci://$CHART_REPO"
